subject: Installation of the package DT failed due to port restriction / Is there an alternative way possible

messages.author: 185b691c84b200d6
messages.subject: Installation of the package DT failed due to port restriction / Is there an alternative way possible
parts:
Hi,

I have difficulties to install DT as our firewall is blocking port 443.

devtools::install_github("rstudio/DT")
Downloading github repo rstudio/DT@master
Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE)  : 
  Failed to connect to api.github.com port 443: Connection refused

Is there an alternative installation method available or when do you plan to push DT to CRAN?

Best regards,

Jürgen

PS: It's a great package. I am already using it on my private computer!

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Installation of the package DT failed due to port restriction / Is there an alternative way possible
parts:
The release to CRAN will probably take place in two or three weeks.
For now, you can install it from this _temporary_ repository:

install.packages(
'DT',
type = 'source',
repos = c('http://yihui.name/xran', 'http://cran.rstudio.com')
)

Regards,
Yihui
